semantic.justification: Task199 adds the default-mode shared scalar arithmetic token-to-RPN subset over the existing FormulaTokenArray. Native recursive precedence, original token identities, prefix-plus elision, whitespace skipping, first-error virtual boundary, expression/token recursion limits, forced recalc retention and subtotal-return meaning are preserved for supported tokens. The base error hook remains the actual native empty operation. Unsupported opcode families, existing array-context tokens and implicit-intersection/matrix modes reject explicitly before RPN mutation. No text scanner, function/reference-operator grammar, formula-cell evaluation/recalc, ODS, UI, full compiler constructor/services, or broad parity is claimed. Existing token-array limit bounds emitted scalar RPN; native overflow paths requiring expansions are outside this subset. Scope reduction is explicit and broad flags remain unverified. Task200 keeps the original mutable protected array pointer so ScCompiler::CompileString can bind its actual newly returned token owner. No new parsing algorithm or broad shared compiler parity is claimed. Task202 serializes actual source-order scalar ODFF tokens through shared FormulaCompiler and ScCompiler reference convention into ScFormulaCell.GetFormula with explicit grammar. It preserves forced equals, source whitespace/quotes, native numeric presentation and relative/absolute A1 references at the actual cell position. It neither evaluates formulas nor stores an alternate text model. The shared native base reference hook remains empty; Calc overrides it. JS strings replace buffer fragments; actual OUString assignment preserves output ownership. Other grammars/localized symbol services,functions/names/external/range/matrix/table references and missing-argument rewrite services remain unsupported. Compiler string token output does not imply string-expression evaluation. Localized empty-code errors reject explicitly. ODS filters and UI are not implemented by this task; no broad native parity is certified. Task N4JV15 adds the native OOO A1 convention for the existing arithmetic/local-reference subset (GRAM_NATIVE, GRAM_ENGLISH and GRAM_ODFF_A1), sharing actual source/RPN tokens, relative/absolute flags and document listeners with ODFF. Native and ODFF output round-trip the same formula owner without evaluation. Scalar operator spellings in this subset coincide across the represented languages; localized numeric input, function names and separators remain unsupported. Native deleted/out-of-range column and row fragments follow ConventionOOO_A1. No UI formula rewrite, second model or broad compiler parity claim. Block72 ports ordinary SUM/SUMSQ/PRODUCT/AVERAGE variable arguments,English/ODFF symbols,quoted string/missing tokens and byte arity255 through the actual shared compiler and Calc token/document/interpreter owners. Numeric and single-reference parameters use original portable non-SSE2 KahanSum operations;native argument order,empty/text/error behavior and final average/product defaults are preserved. Real input/history/dependency/ODS/primary storage paths consume these owners. Range/area broadcasts and array accumulation are planned in dependent73;other functions,localized conversion,external/named/matrix references and nondefault subtotal/format services remain unsupported. This bounded slice does not certify broad native parity. Block73 extends the prior bounded slices with native local/ODFF rectangular and whole-axis double references,shared RangeLine compilation,default scalar intersection,range aggregate execution over actual typed stores,and ordinary area-slot dependency ownership. Native logarithmic slot geometry,shared identity,bulk/deferred erasure,reference-update chaining,sheet shifts and semantic destruction are consumed without individual-cell listener expansion. ScValueIterator and RangeColumnSpanSet use actual document/column stores;portable array accumulation retains original four-stream Kahan order. Typed double out-references preserve encoded NaN payload storage. Earlier exclusions of these specific services are superseded here. Group/3D/external/named-reference expressions,matrix evaluation,nondefault subtotal/text-zero and number-format services remain unsupported;broader parity remains unverified. CALC250-252 record retained upstream edge behavior and limits on numerical evidence. Block75 group ownership/listener work in progress adds original token GenHash,hash-aware copy/move/Clear and source-token equality. Size_t and double hashing bind to the observed libc++64 primitive profile,consistent with the existing OUStringHash64 target;11 real primitive outputs match normal and ASan/UBSan,without claiming whole Calc native differential or32-bit/other standard-library ABI parity. ScCompiler generates the hash at the original source-scanning stage. Original shared compiler return-format lifecycle and the SvNumFormatType values support actual cell/group metadata. The owned-array formula constructor now preserves existing RPN and errors rather than recompiling source order. ScFormulaCellGroup owns real shared code;cell creation,sharing/unsharing,synchronization,top destruction and position queries retain actual identities. Group listeners borrow actual mdds formula block pointers,select formulas under all fixed/relative row policies,and consume real sparse segmented ColumnSpanSet bulk spans. Area keys include the group flag;native ordinary/group bulk delivery,sorted listener-key teardown and actual Svt query result owners are represented. CALC255-256 retain source overnotification and conditional grouped-area ownership suspicions. This does not complete production column comparison/join/split/rejoin,group admission contexts,document modes,compileCode/compute-II services,table-operation cell services or clipboard fill/paste Undo. Those and final all-Calc/changed-shared raw100,browser/Worker/ODS/native observations and task acceptance remain pending. No broad behavior,contract or default parity is certified. Block75 compute-II work in progress ports the original238-row classification table,seven-slot RunData initialization,repeat indexing,Unknown fallback,macro/return/signed-opcode behavior and explicit Init/Exit cache lifetime. Static data audit matches every original row;this is not native class execution. External AddIn argument collections remain explicitly unported,with the original Unknown return-type result retained. The existing per-realm compiler symbol bootstrap invokes actual classification Init after symbols,corresponding to that portion of native ScGlobal::Init without a replacement global service. Original shared compiler compute-II flag,empty virtual hooks,borrowed actual RPN buffer/offset locations,eight-argument cap and PostProcessCode timing are represented. Calc schedules and applies local scalar arithmetic II replacements only after final context,while preserving lexical ranges,relative flags and source exclusions for fully absolute rows,trivial or ambiguous ranges. Existing unsupported opcode/array/matrix admission remains explicit. ScFormulaCell owns actual native cMatrixFlag/GetMatrixFlag,explicit precompiled-token mode construction and copied mode state. Original matrix-reference formula output resolves its actual local RPN reference through the document and falls back to real source tokens when the origin is absent;non-normal output retains native braces. Matrix compilation and evaluation remain explicit unsupported services rather than scalar substitutes. The owned-array constructor creates a compiler only when RPN is missing,as in source. The classification constant-table diagnostic branch is specialized only for the proved invariant that all238 actual upstream repeated rows supply at least their repeat count of leading parameters;the source-data audit asserts that invariant. Twelve actual libc++64 double-hash bit patterns now match normal and ASan/UBSan,including a finite value whose native folded token hash is one. This is a primitive observation,not a full native Calc differential. Actual group compileCode enables II for missing RPN and retains precompiled,error and subtotal-detection branches. Source default column/table group listeners and earlier copy/ownership work remain unchanged. CALC258 preserves the source fallback-comment discrepancy. This does not complete document modes/pool identity,full native differential or final raw100/quality acceptance.
